# Vanilla conflicts

Every group of vanilla enchantments that conflict, read from Minecraft 26.3's `exclusive_set`s. An item can hold a whole group; one at a time is active (or more, where they don't conflict with each other, like Loyalty and Channeling). Datapacks and the server's [`[exclusivity]`](../guide/server-config.md#which-enchantments-conflict) settings can change these; [tags](../guide/tags.md) explains how.

## Bane of Arthropods, Breach, Density, Impaling, Sharpness, Smite

| Enchantment | Id | Max level | Conflicts with |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bane of Arthropods | `minecraft:bane_of_arthropods` | 5 | Breach, Density, Impaling, Sharpness, Smite |
| Breach | `minecraft:breach` | 4 | Bane of Arthropods, Density, Impaling, Sharpness, Smite |
| Density | `minecraft:density` | 5 | Bane of Arthropods, Breach, Impaling, Sharpness, Smite |
| Impaling | `minecraft:impaling` | 5 | Bane of Arthropods, Breach, Density, Sharpness, Smite |
| Sharpness | `minecraft:sharpness` | 5 | Bane of Arthropods, Breach, Density, Impaling, Smite |
| Smite | `minecraft:smite` | 5 | Bane of Arthropods, Breach, Density, Impaling, Sharpness |

## No conflicts

Aqua Affinity, Curse of Binding, Efficiency, Feather Falling, Fire Aspect, Flame, Knockback, Looting, Luck of the Sea, Lunge, Lure, Power, Punch, Quick Charge, Respiration, Soul Speed, Sweeping Edge, Swift Sneak, Thorns, Unbreaking, Curse of Vanishing, Wind Burst.
